description_zh: 为指定的异步复制关系停止异步复制功能
kebab_example: aliyun ebs stop-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-pair-id pair-cn-dsa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopDiskReplicaPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the replication pair. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html operation to query the region information of replication pairs
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354206.html查询存量异步复制关系的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair
parameters.name: replica_pair_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
